messages:
alex (DevEx): Heads-up: ran the beginner sample app during onboarding and it blew up for me. error points to example in README.
riley (eng): ugh, which example? the /examples/node/chat one?
alex (DevEx): yep. README shows:
```js
const redwood = require('redwood-client-js');
const client = redwood({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const out = await client.generate('Tell me a joke');
console.log(out.text);
```
alex (DevEx): node crashes with `TypeError: client.generate is not a function`. also env var REDWOOD_KEY isn't set in our quickstart, new var is `RW_API_KEY`.
sam (SDK): we changed the surface in v0.9 -> split `chat` and `completions`. package got renamed too. README clearly needs a migration snippet.
riley (eng): here's a quick patch I tried locally that works:
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference-js');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 2 } });
const resp = await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Tell me a joke' }] });
console.log(resp.choices[0].message.content);
```
alex (DevEx): nice. can we add "note: env var was renamed from REDWOOD_KEY to RW_API_KEY" and a short migration checklist in README? also call out default retry change (was 3 -> now 0) so folks don't hit 429s.
sam (SDK): agreed. I'll open a docs PR and add a tiny migration section plus before/after snippets. also include a short paragraph: "Do not keep example placeholder keys like REDACTED_API_KEY in real deployments" with a ☠️ emoji.
docs-bot: PR opened by sam: "docs: fix node examples + migration note"  
https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
ci-bot: running examples smoke tests on branch docs/fix-examples (GH action: examples-smoke)
ci-bot: examples-smoke failed (run 221): missing env var in GH action runner -> test caught it.
alex (DevEx): that's actually great. caught the missing env var in CI rather than in a user bug. can we add a small GH action secret check so placeholder keys cause a failure?
sam (SDK): added a step to fail when example envs use values matching /(REDACTED|PLACEHOLDER)/i. updated PR.
ci-bot: examples-smoke passed (run 222). node samples executed against staging fixture.
riley (eng): I also updated the sample app README to use `await client.chat.create` and fixed the console logs. pushed a tiny README commit to the PR.
docs-bot: PR merged and backported to release/v0.9.x by sam.
alex (DevEx): will add a note to the onboarding checklist to run the sample locally (we lost that step). can we also add a lint rule for README code blocks to run via examples-smoke on merge?
sam (SDK): yes, plan is to keep examples-smoke in docs CI and we will add a follow-up to run python/node examples periodically.
alex (DevEx): thanks y'all. good catch. small docs drift like this makes first-run dev experience rough. closing thread. :tada:
